issues.detail: Assertion 0 requires heading_ids prefix D min 2 in the synchronization record. The skill lets a correct run treat the unrecorded unstaged change as an ambiguous active boundary and record it as a gap/limitation with a blocking user question (graderOnly itself calls 'recording all gaps and asking the user' defensible), or record one Developer-owned IMPLEMENTATION discrepancy with the stale verification and stale final review listed as dependent gaps in Limitations and Remaining Work. Both preserve both gaps yet produce fewer than two D-NNN headings, so the check can fail a correct run. Whether both gaps are preserved, and before routing, is a judge call.
